'''Resputi-seals''',<ref name="CL" /> also known as just '''resputi''', were enormous [[Diet/Legends|predators]] that lurked in the lowest levels<ref name="CSWE" /> of the deep sinkhole [[Cave/Legends|caves]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="CL" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}}, as depicted in [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']], to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> fierce resputi-seals had made a lair in caverns beside a [[Bone/Legends|bone]] [[Mining/Legends|mine]] above the [[Water/Legends|pools]] and grottos of [[Coranth/Legends|Coranth]] in the [[Mining Level/Legends|Mining Level]] of the sinkhole of [[Pau City/Legends|Pau City]] on Utapau. The breeding resputi-seals frequently attacked mine workers who entered their territory. Despite the risk of encountering a resputi-seal or other ferocious predators in the darkness of the caves, the grottos and pools of the Mining Level were still a popular place to relax.<ref name="CL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Resputi-seals were first mentioned in the [[2005]] reference book [[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']], which was written by [[Kerrie Dougherty]]. The book provided the names "resputi-seal" and "rasputi" for the creatures<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> but the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' used the spelling "resputi" and so this article treats the "rasputi" spelling as an error.<ref name="CSWE" />
